notes: CMVP certificate pages do not list operating environments; they are inherited from the linked CAVP validations.
Modules-in-process and IUT lists carry no algorithms; PQC evidence is inferred from vendor/name matching and must be treated as indicative (see pqc_evidence).
OS family, product, version and CPU architecture are normalized heuristically from CAVP operating-environment text.
Security policy PDFs are extracted best-effort: the raw tested and vendor-affirmed OE sections are authoritative, while the OS/CPU candidate columns are regex hints, not compliance evidence.

Implementation language is inferred from NIST descriptions, product names, or a curated upstream-library map; impl_language_source records which. Hardware and firmware without evidence are not_applicable; empty with none means unknown.
